study: Early et al. 2016, Every Classroom Every Day (ECED), JREE 9(1)
delivery_evidence: Teacher supports = instructional coaching, weekly meetings, summer workshops, and four annual IRRE site visits with half-day on-site PD sessions (Method, p.~8). Coach conference calls are for coaches/leaders, not teacher PD; teacher-facing PD is face-to-face.
test_alignment_evidence: Outcomes = district/state standardized math & ELA tests (CST, TCAP/EOC, AIMS, NYSTP/Regents, Stanford 10), broad independent assessments standardized within test/district (Table 3, p.19).
curriculum_evidence: ECED's Literacy Matters provides 'a research-based, structured literacy curriculum' delivered in a stand-alone class ('ECED provides a literacy curriculum'); PD tied to adopting new ELA materials (Literacy Matters section, p.~). (ECED Math is a delivery system, not a curriculum, but the bundled literacy curriculum governs the shared design.)
outcome_timing_evidence: Extracted primary effects = end of Year 2 (end of the 2-year treatment); Year 1 rows are interim and excluded centrally (Table 3, p.19; notes).
